user.title: EV Planner
user.description: Set up EV Planner for your household. Add your cars and chargers afterwards on the integration page.

data_description.name: Shown as the name of the integration.
data_description.price_entity: A sensor with prices for today and tomorrow (hourly or 15-minute), such as Energi Data Service or Nord Pool.
data_description.country: Country used for license plate lookup of guest cars.
data_description.motorapi_api_key: Optional, for looking up guest cars by license plate. Get a free key at motorapi.dk.

data_description.notify_services: Where reminders, live notifications and messages go, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_iphone. Live notifications need the companion app.
data_description.update_widgets: Ask the iOS companion app to refresh its widgets when a car's status changes (at most every 15 minutes).

user.title: Add car
user.description: Start from a car in EV Smart Charging, or from scratch. EV Smart Charging is not changed.

details.title: Car
details.description: Tell EV Planner about the car. Settings such as target, ready by and rules are changed in the panel or with the car's entities.

data_description.name: For example Tesla Model 3.
data_description.battery_capacity: Usable capacity in kWh. Used when the car does not report it itself.

sensors.name: Sensors from the car
sensors.description: Leave empty what the car does not have.

data_description.soc_entity: The car's battery level (%). Without it, you set the level by hand.
data_description.target_entity: The car's own charge limit (%). A number entity is also changed when you change the target in EV Planner.
data_description.capacity_entity: Optional. A sensor with the car's usable battery capacity (kWh). Replaces the number above while it has a value.
data_description.connected_entity: An entity that shows whether the car is plugged in, e.g. a charge cable sensor.
data_description.unplugged_states: Default: off, disconnected, unplugged. For a status sensor, e.g. 3.
data_description.home_entity: Optional. EV Planner only acts while the car is home.
data_description.charging_entity: Optional. Shows whether the car is charging (on/charging, or a power above 0). Used to check that charging started.

charging.name: Charging at home
charging.description: Where the car charges, and who starts and stops it.

data_description.charge_power: What the car draws from the grid when charging at home (kW).
data_description.charger: The charger the car uses. Cars on the same charger share it.
data_description.control: Choose the car, the charger, or neither.
data_description.control_entity: Needed when the car starts and stops charging, e.g. switch.model3_charge.

data_description.calendar_entity: Trips in this calendar set when the car must be ready.
data_description.calendar_keyword: Only events with this word. Write e.g. 90 % in the event to charge to 90 %.

user.title: Add charger
user.description: Choose the charger's device in Home Assistant, if it has one, and EV Planner fills in the rest. You can check everything on the next page.

data_description.device: Optional. The charger's device from its own integration (Easee, Zaptec, Wallbox, ...).
data_description.model: Automatic finds it from the device.

details.title: Charger
details.description: Check what EV Planner filled in. Leave empty what the charger does not have.

data_description.name: For example Carport.
data_description.model: Brand and model. Decides the picture in the panel.
data_description.power: The most the charger gives with your installation (kW). Typically 11 kW on 3 x 16 A, 7.4 kW on 1 x 32 A.
data_description.switch_entity: Optional. Lets EV Planner start and pause this charger.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional. The charger's total energy (kWh), to measure what the guest used.
data_description.connected_entity: Optional. Ends the guest session when the guest car is unplugged.

state.lower_ceiling: Lower the ceiling when cheap prices are coming

reminder_price_enabled.name: Remind only at a low price

options.car: The car starts and stops charging
options.charger: The charger starts and stops charging

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Set a car's mode: smart, charge now, pause or off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Smart follows the plan. Charge now charges until the target is reached.

guest_lookup.name: Look up guest car
guest_lookup.description: Look up the guest car from its license plate.

guest_plan.name: Make guest plan
guest_plan.description: Plan the cheapest charging for the guest car.

guest_charge_now.name: Charge guest car now
guest_charge_now.description: Charge the guest car right away until its target, whatever the price. The charge is saved in the history.

guest_stop.name: Stop guest charging
guest_stop.description: Stop the guest's charging now. What was charged is saved in the history, and the charger stays paused for the guest car until it is unplugged.

new_guest.name: New guest
new_guest.description: Forget the guest car and its plan; a finished plan goes to the history.
